#


Indexed Data: Understand what's happening onchain


Indexed Data turns raw blockchain activity into structured datasets that Quicknode builds and keeps current. Start with the answer, then query it in SQL, call it from your product, or have new activity pushed to your systems.


[Quicknode](https://www.quicknode.com/blog/author/quicknode)


November 23, 2026 — 4 min read


Share


[Add as preferred source](https://www.google.com/preferences/source?q=quicknode.com)


Do our books match what moved onchain this month? Treasury teams ask that at every month-end. Compliance and analytics teams ask their own versions: what moved through a wallet, who was on the other side, and how flows have shifted. Today we're introducing Quicknode[Indexed Data](https://www.quicknode.com/indexed-data) , so those teams can start with the answer.


## **What Indexed Data is**


Indexed Data turns raw blockchain activity into structured datasets that Quicknode builds and keeps current. Your team can query them in SQL, call them from your product, or have new activity pushed to your systems.


Asset Transfers leads the launch, on[Ethereum](https://www.quicknode.com/chains/ethereum) ,[Robinhood Chain](https://www.quicknode.com/chains/robinhood) ,[Arc](https://www.quicknode.com/chains/arc) ,[Elysium](https://www.quicknode.com/chains/elysium) ,[Base](https://www.quicknode.com/chains/base) ,[Arbitrum One](https://www.quicknode.com/chains/arbitrum) , and[BNB Smart Chain](https://www.quicknode.com/chains/bsc) . It holds every coin, token, and NFT transfer, including transfers made inside smart contract calls, back to each network's first block. It sits alongside Hyperliquid HyperCore data, with raw chain data on supported networks. The indexing is already running, so your team starts on the question.


## **Start with the answer**


**A month reconciled.** A treasury team picks a wallet and a month and gets every USDC transfer in and out, with the date, direction, counterparty, and amount. Inflows and outflows total up, ready to tie out against the books.


**A wallet traced.** A compliance team looks up a wallet and gets its top USDC counterparties ranked by volume, with the count and total value of transfers to and from each.


**Liquidations by market.** A research team pulls the past 24 hours of Hyperliquid liquidations, grouped by market with the count and notional value of each.


Each is one query in[SQL Explorer](https://www.quicknode.com/sql-explorer) . Your team can write it with an AI assistant: connect it to SQL Explorer through the Quicknode MCP server, describe the question in plain language, and review the SQL it drafts.


## **Data delivered your way**


Access data how your team needs it.


-


[SQL Explorer](https://www.quicknode.com/sql-explorer) **:** investigate a wallet or build a report in the browser.


-


[SQL API](https://www.quicknode.com/docs/sql-explorer/using-rest-api) **:** send the same queries to a REST endpoint from scripts, BI tools, and month-end jobs.


-


[Explorer API](https://www.quicknode.com/docs/ethereum/explorer-api) **(new):** pull transfer history into your product on demand through JSON-RPC (qn_getAssetTransfers), with readable addresses in and out and up to 25 wallets per request.


-


[Streams](https://www.quicknode.com/streams) **:** have new activity pushed to a webhook, S3, Azure, Kafka, or Postgres as it arrives.


Coverage spans Hyperliquid HyperCore, Ethereum, Robinhood Chain, Arc, BNB Smart Chain, Base, Arbitrum One, and Elysium, and varies by dataset.


## **Who it's for**


It's built for the teams that answer for onchain activity.


-


**Compliance and investigations:** trace every transfer and counterparty across a wallet's history, usually starting in SQL Explorer.


-


**Institutional and treasury:** close the month with the flows for every wallet you report on, often on a schedule through the SQL API.


-


**Analytics and research:** query as many wallets and as much history as the analysis needs.


-


**Wallets and apps:** show every user their full transfer history, built on the Explorer API.


## **Built and run by Quicknode**


Quicknode runs the whole pipeline: we connect directly to each chain, index the raw blocks ourselves, and deliver the data you query. New activity is added as it lands onchain.


We've run onchain infrastructure for nine years and handle 500B+ requests a month across the platform. We're ISO/IEC 27001 certified, and our SOC 1 Type 2 and SOC 2 Type 2 reports are available on request. Enterprise teams also work with a named solutions architect. Raw chain data, curated datasets, and live delivery all sit on one account. If you're already on an eligible Quicknode plan, Indexed Data is available on the account you have, built on the same infrastructure as your RPC.


## **More indexed data**


The Indexed Data family also includes APIs for Bitcoin and other UTXO networks (Blockbook-compatible), Ordinals and Runes, Solana tokens and NFTs (Metaplex DAS), and onchain agent identity (ERC-8004).


## **Get started**


Start with a question you already answer by hand.


-


**Query it yourself:** open[SQL Explorer](https://dashboard.quicknode.com/sql) and run your first query. It's available on eligible paid plans and billed in API credits.


-


**Talk it through:** tell us what you need to report on or build, and a solutions architect will map it to the data.


-


**Build with the**[Explorer API](https://www.quicknode.com/docs/ethereum/explorer-api) **:** the docs have the API reference and example requests.
